newsitem.title: GREECE: Bank of Greece drains 200bln drs at 11.9pct.
newsitem.headline: Bank of Greece drains 200bln drs at 11.9pct.

text.p: Bank of Greece drained 200 billion drachmas of 14-day funds at 11.90 percent in today's money tender, it said .
The fixed rate tender was oversubscribed, it added.
"Individual bids were thus satisfied pro rata on the basis of the ensuing allotment ratio of 11.85 percent.
A 14-day depo pact for 200 billion drachmas expires today, so liquidity is virtually unchanged. --Dimitris Kontogiannis, Athens Newsroom +301 3311812-4
